name: Soul Breach
storyline:
Ten years ago, the gods stopped answering our call. Whether they died or abandoned us, no one knows.

With their disappearance, the balance between the five primordial races was broken. Centuries of hatred and rancor led to a war that threatens all of creation. And their war has reached our world.

The primordials, even the celestials we revered, fight each other to enslave and subjugate the creatures of other worlds, forcing them to participate in their war.

When a primordial is destroyed, its immortal spirit travels to its world by entering a gem, from which it will be reborn again.

During their war, the primordial races use the gems as a prison, sealing their enemies and thus preventing them from being reborn.

Primordial beings cannot break a gem. Only some mortals, known as Faerel, are able to break them. And the ritual of breaking allows us to control the freed primordial, forcing it to fight even against its own race.
summary: Soul Breach is a F2P turn-based combat RPG that challenges you to collect, upgrade, and command a collection of legendary creatures in tactical battles. Every creature is shaped by ancient forces, evolving with each battle and ensuring no two are ever the same. Master the battlefield by unleashing powerful hero abilities, using sacred relics to enhance your creatures or weaken your enemies. Develop your strategy, refine your synergy, and prove your dominance in a world shaped by power and destiny.
